historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun, the 14th-century Arab historian and sociologist, mentioned a Berber dynasty named the Banu Ma'qil (or Banu Maghil) in his book 'Al-'Ibar'. He described Jaed ibn Munqidh as a chief of this dynasty, who ruled in the 12th century.

Al-Maqrizi, another prominent 15th-century Egyptian historian, wrote in his book 'Al-Mawāʾiʿ wa-l-Iʿtibār fī Aḥkām al-Masrīyīn' about a Berber warrior named Ja'far ibn 'Abd al-'Aziz al-Ja'dī, who was a notable military commander under the Ayyubid sultan Saladin in the late 12th century.
